Extract face from a brep by given direction

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `FFromDir`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Brep | `B` | Brep | Item |  | Brep for face extraction |
| Direction | `D` | Vector | Item | `Vector3d.ZAxis` | Directions to filter |
| Angle | `A` | Number | Item | `0.0` | Direction angle tolerance |
| Reverse | `R` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Reverse the direction |
| Both | `B` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Both directions |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Faces | `F` | Brep | List | Found faces |
| Indices | `i` | Integer | List | Face indices |

## Right-click menu

Options in the component's context menu:

- Normal
- Cull
